channel.title: The Grant Desk - Research & Journalism, EU, added in last 30 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Research & Journalism, EU, added in last 30 days, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 4 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
4 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 24 Aug 2026 (24 Aug to 30 Aug 2026).

  • Sphera Media Lab 2026: Open Call for Masterclasses and Keynotes
    European Lab (Arty Farty) and the Sphera Network, coordinated by Medianes · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Selected contributors receive a fee plus travel to Brussels and accommodation, all covered by the organisers. The fee amount is not published in the call. No...
  • Fonds BJP: Dossiersubsidie for Freelance Regional and Local Journalists (autumn 2026 round)
    Fonds Bijzondere Journalistieke Projecten (Fonds BJP) · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 19,200 for six months of work on a single reporting dossier. No application fee.
  • Programme PAUSE: Emergency Hosting for Scientists and Artists in Exile (autumn 2026 call)
    Programme PAUSE, hosted by the College de France, with the French Ministries of Higher Education and Research and of Culture · deadline 24 Sep 2026 · PAUSE co-funds the hosting project (salary and support costs) together with the host institution; amounts depend on the project and institution.
